items.title: 8.12 The effect of change of concentrations (concentration badalne ka asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.12, printed page 180.

blocks.text: Agar system equilibrium par ho aur kisi reactant ya product ki kuch amount (miqdar) dal di jaye ya nikal di jaye, to equilibrium ki position disturb ho jati hai.
Reactants aur products ki concentration badalne ki chaar possibilities (soorten) hain.
(I) Hydrolysis of BiCl₃ (BiCl₃ ka pani se tootna)
Yeh reversible reaction lein jis mein BiCl₃ pani se react kar ke safed, na ghulne wala (insoluble) compound BiOCl banata hai.
Is reaction ka sahi expression yeh hai (solid BiOCl aur solvent pani Kc mein nahi aate):

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Kc = [BiOCl][HCl]² / [BiCl₃][H₂O] likha hai aur kaha hai ke BiOCl dalne ya nikalne se equilibrium shift hota hai. BiOCl na ghulne wala solid hai aur pani solvent hai; in ki concentration constant rehti hai, is liye yeh Kc mein nahi likhe jate (topic 8.6 ka 'Keep in Mind'). Is liye thora sa BiOCl dalne ya nikalne se equilibrium nahi hilta; sirf HCl ya BiCl₃ badalne se position badalti hai.

BiCl₃ ke solution mein pani dalne se woh safed precipitate BiOCl ki wajah se cloudy (dhundla) ho jata hai. Equilibrium par kuch BiOCl aur HCl ban chuke hote hain aur BiCl₃ ke kuch moles bache hote hain. Agar equilibrium par BiCl₃ ke kuch moles aur dal dein to reaction forward taraf dhakeli jati hai.

BiCl₃ ya H₂O dalne se equilibrium disturb hota hai. Dobara equilibrium banane ke liye aur BiOCl aur HCl bante hain, yani reaction forward chalti hai. Kc constant rehta hai, magar position badal jati hai.
HCl dalne se equilibrium disturb hota hai. Dobara equilibrium banane ke liye aur BiCl₃ banta hai aur reaction reverse taraf chalti hai. Kc constant, position badli.
Agar equilibrium par kuch BiCl₃ nikal liya jaye to us kami ko poora karne ke liye reaction reverse taraf chalti hai. Naya equilibrium banta hai aur Kc constant rehta hai.
Agar equilibrium par kuch HCl nikal liya jaye to reaction us kami ko poora karne ke liye forward chalti hai. Naya equilibrium banta hai; Kc phir bhi constant rehta hai.

blocks.prompt: Equilibrium par 2H₂(g) + O₂(g) ⇌ 2H₂O(g) mein aur steam (pani ki bhaap) dal di jaye to H₂ aur O₂ ki concentrations ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Product dalne se equilibrium disturb hota hai aur dali hui bhaap ka kuch hissa kharch karne ke liye left shift hota hai. Is mein H₂ aur O₂ bante hain, is liye in ki concentrations barhti hain; Kc wahi rehta hai.

items: Reactant dalein ya product nikalein: forward shift. Product dalein ya reactant nikalein: reverse shift.
BiCl₃ ka hydrolysis: Kc = [HCl]² / [BiCl₃]; position badalti hai, Kc nahi.
